summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the Payslip Module enhancement at desktop 1920x1080 (admin/pass123 on the local test DB, payslip code 082026). Everything requested passed. Templates: the new controls (auto-reconcile unchecked by default, employer PF copy-from-employee 12/3000/Basic Pay, gratuity 793 with prorate checked, compliance note) show up and save; the DB holds the correct pf/employer_pf/gratuity configs with auto_reconcile=false. Versions: saving a new version from Sep 2026 shows the toast, the row shows '2 versions · latest from September 2026', the select lists V1 'from the start' and V2 'from September 2026', and switching loads max 3000 or 1800. Assignments: Effective From offers Joining, Confirmation and Custom Month; Effective Until offers Ongoing and End Month with month pickers. An ongoing assignment from Aug 2026 saved. History shows the 'Current' badge, and Edit period saves ('Effective period updated'). A closed older period Jan-Jul 2026 on another template saved. Overlapping periods are rejected with an 'overlaps the existing assignment' toast, both in the assign dialog and in the period editor. Preview: Aug uses V1 (PF 300), Sep uses V2 with the employer contributions table (Employer PF 248, Gratuity 793x4/30=105.73, total 353.73) and the version label; Jul uses the old template with no employer section; Dec 2025 shows the 'No Payslip Template assignment is available ...' toast. Monthly: generating Sep 2026 works and the view dialog matches the preview; PDF download (Payslip_TEST_UI_Employee_2026-09.pdf) and Confirm work. Snapshot: after changing V2's PF max to 100, the confirmed slip still shows 248 while the preview shows 100. No layout breakage in the template form, assign dialog or history dialog.

issues: The PF (DEDUCTION) row in Retirement Benefits (C) shows the prorated amount in the FULL MONTH column (e.g. 248.00). The real full-month PF should be min(15500x12%, max), e.g. 1800, so the column is misleading.
Templates using the new pf_config show no PF / Employer PF / Gratuity chip in the Components column (only the components). Older templates show a 'PF · 12%' chip. Consider a small indicator.

design_issues.screen: Calculation breakdown for templates without pf_config
issues: The Total Deductions label reads '(PF + Gratuity)' even when no PF/gratuity applies (old template, deductions 0). Cosmetic.

action_items: Optional: show the true full-month PF (capped) in the FULL MONTH column of the PF row.
Optional: add a PF/Employer PF/Gratuity indicator chip in the templates list for configured templates.

Housekeeping: the local test DB still has leftover backend-pytest data (TEST_PF_* / TEST_VH_* templates, employees, and confirmed payslips for 2026-08/2026-09) from earlier runs. These appear in the UI lists and get picked up by 'Generate'.
critical_code_review_comments: Payslips.js is about 1618 lines; it should be split further (TemplateForm, AssignDialog, MonthlyTab, PreviewTab) into separate modules.
submitAssign only checks until < from on the client for custom_month. For Joining/Confirmation Month with an End Month it relies on the backend.
The preview MonthPicker and the Monthly generate MonthPicker have no data-testid wrapper (unlike assign/new-version). Add preview-month / gen-month testids.
